title: CLR/121/2015 of Chandra Prakash Damir Vs Om Prakash Damir

paras.text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND AT NAINITAL
Civil Revision No.121 of 2015
Chandra Prakash Damir
 ÖÖ. Revisionist/Defendant
Versus
Om Prakash Damir
 ....Ö. Respondent/Plaintiff
Mr. Piyush Garg, Advocate for the revisionist.
Mr. V.K. Kaparwan, Advocate for the respondent.
Honíble Servesh Kumar Gupta, J.
 Having heard learned counsel for both the
parties, in question, it transpires that the Original Suit
No.4 of 2013 was initiated by Mr. Om Prakash Damir
against his real brother Mr. Chandra Prakash Damir,
seeking cancellation of the registered Gift Deed dated
11.5.2011.
 The said sale deed was allegedly executed by
Smt. Savitri Devi (mother of both the litigants),
witnessing the signature of Ms. Rita Damir (wife of Mr.
Chandra Prakash Damir). In the opinion of this Court,
simply making the averments that the registered gift
deed was prepared in connivance with Ms. Rita Damir,
is not sufficient so as to drag her in the litigation and to
implead her in the suit as necessary party.
 In the opinion of this Court, Ms. Rita Damir is,
at all, not the necessary party. Rather, she is simply a

2
witness of such deed. If the defendant feels it proper,
then she may be produced as a witness in his favour.
 Thus, in view of what has been set forth above,
the impugned order dated 21.8.2015 passed by the Civil
Judge (Senior Division), Rishikesh, District Dehradun in
the Original Suit No.4 of 2013, Om Prakash Damir v.
Chandra Prakash Damir, is hereby set aside.
 Revision stands allowed accordingly.
